name: 80s OVA neon city-pop
summary: Late-80s direct-to-video cel: glossy idol-faced heroines, chrome hardsuits and rain-slick neon night cities in magenta, cyan and violet.

traits.line: Fine black cel lines; sharp angular hair spikes and shoulder pads; detailed mecha and hardsuit lines (Kenichi Sonoda, Masami Obari).
traits.shading: Multi-tone cel shading: hard shadow plus extra highlight tone; airbrushed gradients on chrome armour and skin; star-shaped specular glints.
traits.palette: Night palette: magenta, hot pink, cyan, violet, electric blue on navy-black; chrome silver; sodium-orange accents.
traits.lighting: Neon backlight, pink and cyan rim light, wet-street reflections, hand-painted lens flares and glows.
traits.faces: Glossy 80s idol faces: big eyes with several highlights, voluminous feathered or permed hair, strong lip colour.
traits.backgrounds: Painted megacity at night: towers, elevated highways, neon signs, rain (Megatokyo, Blade Runner influence).
traits.texture: Film grain, VHS/laserdisc softness, halation around lights, cel dust.
traits.camera: Music-video montage: freeze frames, slow pans on posed silhouettes, speed-line action.

style_words: Late-1980s OVA cel animation: fine black lines, hard multi-tone cel shadows with airbrushed chrome gradients and star glints, neon magenta, cyan and violet against navy-black night, hand-painted rim light, lens flares and halation, rain-slick reflections, film grain and VHS softness, as in Bubblegum Crisis (1987) and Megazone 23 (1985).
avoid: modern synthwave vector retro with grid sunsets

krea2.style: Late-1980s OVA cel animation, as in Bubblegum Crisis: fine black lines, hard multi-tone cel shadows with airbrushed chrome sheen and star-shaped glints, idol-pretty stylised faces, deep neon magenta, cyan and violet against navy-black night, hand-painted rim light, lens flares and halation, rain-slick reflections, film grain and VHS softness.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as late-1980s OVA cel animation with film grain and VHS softness.

flux3_klein.style: Late-1980s OVA anime cel animation in the register of Bubblegum Crisis: fine black cel lines with sharp angular hair spikes, hard multi-tone cel shadows with an extra highlight tone, airbrushed chrome gradients on metal and skin, small star-shaped specular glints, hand-painted rim light, painted lens flares and halation around every light, glossy 1980s idol faces with big eyes holding several highlights, painted skies and hand-painted backgrounds, visible film grain, cel dust and VHS-era softness on every edge.
flux3_klein.recap: Magenta and cyan appear only as rim light on edges and as reflections on wet or polished surfaces, violet and navy-black fill the sky, the walls and the shadow fills, sodium orange stays inside lamp, candle and window light, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a late-1980s OVA cel animation frame in a signature Bubblegum Crisis style, with fine black cel lines, hard multi-tone cel shadows with an extra highlight tone, airbrushed chrome-like gradients and star-shaped glints, hand-painted rim light, lens flares and halation around lights, film grain and soft VHS haze, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of neon magenta, hot pink, cyan and violet against navy-black night, with chrome silver and sodium-orange accents.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition sets its figures and forms as posed silhouettes edged by glowing pink and cyan rim light, with a glossy nocturnal mood, keeps to a palette of neon magenta, hot pink, cyan and violet against navy-black night, with chrome silver and sodium-orange accents, and reads throughout as a late-1980s OVA cel animation frame in a signature Bubblegum Crisis style, with fine black cel lines, hard multi-tone cel shadows with an extra highlight tone, airbrushed chrome-like gradients and star-shaped glints, hand-painted rim light, lens flares and halation around lights, film grain and soft VHS haze.
